answer: Registration is free; earning is not. Each epoch asks every key for original text on a garden that rotates unpredictably. Rewards vest over many epochs while transfers do not. A farm cannot convert one lucky grade into liquid value, and each extra key adds only slow capped income, so the mesa of a farm stays negative before any balance matures. So a comet of identities is a subscription, not an acquisition: it bills the operator every epoch and refunds nothing when the panel disagrees. Seal 1e5qb.
